title: Coconut
body:
Coconuts are large, brown fruit with a hard shell and sweet, refreshing water inside.

Description

The Coconut is a item that can be found on Palm trees.

It may be sold to Jer Junkman for $100 per Coconut. In its jam form it may be sold for $400.

Gives a tree climbing ability when put into a jar and drunk.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~3.34% per coconut.
